## SmartBeam 1.2.0

- Adds a subtle purple light pattern while a software update is installing. The beam and battery indicators continue to show their usual status.
- Improves Bluetooth startup diagnostics.
- Tracks lifetime device and battery run time, beam interruptions, and device starts. Compatible apps can read these statistics.
- Improves battery run time tracking when USB power is connected or disconnected, and makes saved usage statistics more reliable.

## SmartBeam 1.1.0

- Fixes a startup issue where the beam indication could incorrectly show green before the beam has been established
